build_CrissCrossAttention_module: build a CrissCrossAttention module with a given number of input channels for feature map processing
run_CrissCrossAttention_forward: run the CrissCrossAttention forward pass on a 4D tensor with shape batch channels height width
create_NEG_INF_DIAG_matrix: create a negative infinity diagonal matrix of size n by n on a specified device
test_CrissCrossAttention_forward: test the CrissCrossAttention forward method by passing a PyTorch tensor and verifying output shape
review_CrissCrossAttention_init: review the CrissCrossAttention constructor to inspect query key and value convolution layer configurations
